scenario_description: Preparation keeps network access, but the production workload runs without egress or host secrets.
expected: Repository preparation succeeds before isolation and the real workload still passes after isolation.
Direct IP and DNS egress both fail during the workload.
Every workload command runs as UID/GID 65534 through an in-container TERM-to-KILL timeout.
No sensitive host environment name is forwarded, the host stays unchanged, and the container is removed.
observed: Preparation completed through SWE-ReX before every Docker network was detached; unittest and add_one(41)=42 then passed.
All four workload commands used docker-exec shell-free as UID/GID 65534 with fixed environment values and the verbose in-container TERM-to-KILL timeout.
Direct and DNS egress were false, sensitive host environment names were absent, memory swap max was recorded, the host snapshot matched, and exact cleanup removed the container.
notes: PASS covers this pinned repository and hardened two-phase primitive; it is not a public-image or multi-tenant production verdict.
